episodeTitle.en: Twitter’s ex-Head of Product on Elon, consumer products, culture, more | Kayvon Beykpour
episodeTitle.zh: 推特前产品主管谈埃隆、消费产品、文化等 | 凯文·贝克波尔

guestBioOfficial.en: Kayvon Beykpour was the longest-serving head of product at Twitter and was GM of Twitter’s consumer division until the platform was acquired by Elon Musk. He originally joined Twitter in 2015 through the acquisition of his company, Periscope, the largest live video streaming platform at the time. Periscope pioneered technology that inspired Instagram Live, TikTok Live, Facebook Live, and other social networks’ expansion into video streaming. In our conversation, we discuss: • The story of being let go from Twitter after Elon’s acquisition
guestBioOfficial.zh: 凯文·贝克波尔是推特任职时间最长的产品主管，在推特被埃隆·马斯克收购前一直担任消费者部门总经理。他最初于2015年通过收购当时最大的实时视频流媒体平台Periscope加入推特。Periscope开创的技术启发了Instagram Live、TikTok Live、Facebook Live等社交网络在视频流媒体领域的扩展。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：•被推特解雇后的经历

title.en: Twitter’s ex-Head of Product on Elon, consumer products, culture, more | Kayvon Beykpour
title.zh: 推特前产品主管谈埃隆、消费产品、文化等 | 凯文·贝克波尔

summary.en: Kayvon describes how he turned Twitter's product team from a stagnant organization into one that shipped constantly by attacking "sacred cows." He shares stories of launching Spaces, Fleets, Twitter Blue, and more, and reflects on his early work with Elon Musk. The episode is a playbook for injecting ambition and momentum into a stuck product culture.
summary.zh: 凯冯讲述了他如何通过攻击"不可动摇的圣牛"，把 Twitter 的产品团队从停滞的组织变成持续发布的团队。他分享了推出 Spaces、Fleets、Twitter Blue 等产品的故事，并回顾了早期与埃隆·马斯克共事的经历。本期是关于如何给陷入停滞的产品文化注入野心与动能的实战手册。
